# 1 Enoch Chapter 61 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** In those days I watched as long measuring-cords were handed to those angels. They grew wings and took flight, heading north.

**2** I asked the angel with me, "Why are these ones going off with cords?" He said to me: "They have gone to measure."

**3** The angel who was traveling with me said: "They will bring back the measurements of the righteous — the measuring-lines of the righteous, for the righteous — so that the righteous may take their stand upon the name of the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.

**4** The elect will begin to live together with the elect. These are the measurements that will be given to faith, and they will reinforce righteousness.

**5** These measurements will bring to light all the hidden things in the depths of the earth — those who were destroyed in the desert, and those who were swallowed by fish in the sea, or devoured by wild animals — so that they may come back and take their stand on the day of the Elect One. For no one is destroyed before the Lord of Spirits; no one can be permanently destroyed."

**6** All who dwell in the heights of heaven received a command — one power, one voice, one light blazing like fire.

**7** That One they praised first of all, and they extolled him and glorified him with wisdom; they were full of insight in word and in the spirit of life.

**8** The Lord of Spirits set the Elect One on the throne of glory. He will judge all the deeds of the holy ones in the heights of heaven; their works will be weighed in the balance.

**9** When he turns his face to judge their hidden ways — judging by the word of the name of the Lord of Spirits and according to the path of the righteous judgment of the Lord Most High — then all of them will speak together in a single voice, blessing, glorifying, exalting, and hallowing the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**10** He will call together the whole heavenly host, all the holy ones on high, the army of God — the Cherubim, the Seraphim, and the Ophanim — all the angels of power, all the angels of the principalities, the Elect One, and every other power on earth and over the sea.

**11** That day they will all raise their voices together and declare: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Spirits — the One who fills the earth with spirits!"

**12** That declaration will trigger a tremendous trembling and a sweeping dread on that day. The Watchers will shake; fear and trembling will grip them all the way to the world's ends.

**13** The towering mountains will shudder, the high hills will collapse, melting like wax in fire. The earth will crack apart completely, and everything on earth will perish — and judgment will fall on everything.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Ch. 61's key moment is v. 8: the Elect One placed on the throne of glory. This sets up ch. 62's judgment scene. The Trisagion in v. 11 is the most direct echo of Isa 6:3 in the entire Parables. The list of angelic orders in v. 10 (Cherubim, Seraphim, Ophanim) is the fullest angelic taxonomy in the Enochic corpus.*
